trends.title: Trends in AI
trends.lede: Frontier AI systems are advancing rapidly from increases in compute, hardware performance, software efficiency, and investment. This dashboard explores those dynamics.
intro: What drives AI progress? The story is dominated by scale. Training AI systems with more compute, power and data has consistently led to better performance. Since 2020, the compute used to train frontier language models has increased 5× per year.

This scale-up comes from three sources: deploying more chips in parallel, training for longer, and leveraging increasingly powerful and cost-effective AI processors. Training costs are climbing by 3.5× annually, and today’s largest AI data centers are approaching a gigawatt of power capacity, enough to power roughly a million US homes.

activity.text: 68 unsolved Erdős problems, with AI systems tasked with writing solutions in Lean. GPT-6.1 Sol leads so far, solving 3 of 68 (4%).

faq.q: How did you choose what benchmarks to evaluate on?
faq.a: For benchmarks we run ourselves, we started with GPQA Diamond and MATH Level 5 because they were convenient to run, not yet saturated, and widely used. We then added harder sets such as Mock AIME 2024–2025, FrontierMath for extremely difficult mathematics, and SWE-bench Verified for resolving realistic GitHub issues. For external benchmarks we prioritize ones that capture economically valuable real-world tasks, are rigorously evaluated and widely used, and would be prohibitively expensive for us to run.

faq.q: How did you choose which models to evaluate?
faq.a: Our top priority is tracking state-of-the-art performance, so we prioritize leading releases from the main AI labs. We are also interested in the best models with downloadable weights, from countries other than the US, or where we have training compute estimates, so we can study how performance varies with accessibility, origin, and compute. We only evaluate the chat or instruct version of each model.

about.title: Making sense of AI
about.lede: Epoch AI was founded to help people understand what is happening in AI from a neutral perspective, grounded in the best possible evidence.
about.mission: Our goal is to improve society’s understanding of the drivers, progress, and impact of artificial intelligence. We build a shared scientific foundation for thinking about AI, neutral to any specific agenda, so decisions about this technology are informed by the best available data.

pillars.name: Drivers
pillars.text: We investigate the drivers and bottlenecks of AI progress and scaling. We were among the first to systematically monitor trends in training compute, and we host leading databases on ML hardware, training compute, investment, GPU clusters, and AI data centers.

pillars.name: Progress
pillars.text: We measure and track the capabilities of AI systems over time, regularly run independent evaluations of new models, review prominent benchmarks, and create new ones such as FrontierMath.

pillars.name: Impacts
pillars.text: We build scientifically grounded models to forecast AI’s impact on the economy, and run polls and interviews on how AI is used and perceived by academics, AI researchers, and the general population.

history.text: Started as a group of volunteers collecting and analyzing data on hundreds of machine learning models, aiming for rigor and empiricism in place of hype.
A widely cited paper on training compute trends leads the group to found Epoch AI and scale up its research.
A multidisciplinary, global, curiosity-driven team helping people and organizations understand and navigate the rapid evolution of AI.

values.name: Be relentlessly curious
values.text: We’re obsessed with understanding AI, and we update our views as new evidence comes in.

values.name: Publish openly
values.text: We default to publishing our research, and showing how we reached our conclusions.

values.name: Stay impartial
values.text: We study facts without an agenda, that everyone can use to inform their thinking.

values.name: Prioritize ruthlessly
values.text: We work on the questions that hold the most promise for advancing understanding.

values.name: Communicate clearly
values.text: We explain our research clearly and compellingly, with interactive visualizations and tools.

values.name: Act with urgency
values.text: Time is our scarcest resource. We move fast and seek feedback early to keep up with the exponential.

values.name: Look after each other
values.text: We want our team to enjoy working at Epoch, and to succeed beyond the goals of the organization.
